rationale: Class 2 within-row check. The raw SOI table header defines the rate column as Coupon (3), not only debt interest. Both flagged PRIVATE_EQUITY positions are preferred-share investments and the source explicitly prints the same coupons stored by the pipeline: 10.50% for Series A preferred shares and 9.31% for TI VI Holdings preferred shares. The flagged interest_rate values therefore match source; the X01 check is overbroad for coupon-bearing preferred equity rather than a data extraction defect.
